claims.content: This page will provide the auction performance history of an individual SKU (“Product ID”).

goal.raw_text: This page will provide the auction performance history of an individual SKU (“Product ID”).

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must be authenticated and logged into the system.
The Auctioneer must have access to the Auction Administration section of the system.
A valid Product ID (SKU) must exist in the system for which auction performance history can be retrieved.
The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on 'Go.'

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on 'Go.'

claims.content: The system displays the SKU History Page for the specified Product ID.
The page presents a summary of key inventory data in terms of cost, units, and unique SKUs.
Under each category, the data includes Auction Available Inventory (Gemstones), Auction Available Inventory (Jewelry), Auction Available Inventory (Other), and Total Auction Available Inventory.
The system counts only products that are both 'Auction Available' AND 'Auction Eligible' in the JTV enterprise systems.
The product must be in a valid, 'sellable' physical inventory location and sellable realm ('white').
The product must have an image available in the JTV SuperNova system to be included in the count.
The system displays the auction performance history of an individual SKU (“Product ID”) in two sections.

The Top Section displays: Product ID, Short “On-Air” description from the SKU Creation application, Product Type, Unit Cost, P1 (Price), Thumbnail Image, Auction History (# of times scheduled, # of sales, churn rate), Buyer’s Name, Auction Available Quantity, Red Available Qty (red inventory realm), White Physical Qty, and Active Date.

The Bottom Section displays auction history data for the SKU on separate lines, including: Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount (i.e., Opening Bid), High Bid, # of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.
Clicking on the Winner/High Bidder takes you to customer’s history.
